ideas.idea: Add a meta description to the /account page
ideas.why: Accurate, but the page is deliberately noindex and private, so a description has almost no effect, as the report itself admits.

ideas.idea: Add address and directions as visible text on the Visit page, since the description promises directions
ideas.why: The visit page body only gives opening months and days, so the description's promise of directions goes unmet.

ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD to the Visit page once address and hours are visible
ideas.why: Having no JSON-LD is explicitly not a required fix, though the report hedges it as optional.

ideas.idea: Give each variety its own page and link to it from the Varieties page
ideas.why: The page claims over forty varieties but names only two, so separate linked pages would make the content findable.

ideas.idea: Add body links from the home page to Varieties and Visit
ideas.why: The nav already links to both pages, so in-body links add only a small benefit.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to sitemap.xml if real update dates are known
ideas.why: This is accurate, but it applies to almost any site and has a small effect on a three-page sitemap.
